name: Origination
description: From an application to a loan. A condition is its own entity because it has wording and a status. A later application can name an existing loan, which is the refinance edge, and a payoff records how much of the new loan retires the old one. Borrower, co-borrowers, and lender are parties, not shapes of the application.

entities.name: Application
entities.description: A request for a loan. Money is an amount plus a currency. The borrower and the home are references into other vocabularies.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The states of an application. Guards that refuse a move are behavior.

attributes.name: coBorrowers
attributes.description: Other people who apply alongside the borrower and share the obligation. The edge carries no terms of its own, so it stays a reference.

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Why the loan is wanted. A refinance is a purpose and a reference to the existing loan, not a second kind of application.

attributes.name: existingLoan
attributes.description: The loan a refinance application is against. Absent on a first loan.

entities.name: Condition
entities.description: A condition is an entity because the connection between an application and what still must be done carries wording and a status. A relationship cannot hold those.

entities.name: Document
entities.description: Evidence filed with an application. Credit, appraisal, and disclosure are values of one enum, not three entities.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: Which kind of evidence this document is.

entities.name: Loan
entities.description: The loan that exists once an application is funded.

entities.name: Payoff
entities.description: A payoff is an entity because the connection between a refinance application and the loan it retires carries an amount and a date. The refinanced-by edge says which loan; it cannot hold how much was paid to close it.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount that retires the existing loan.

attributes.name: goodThrough
attributes.description: The date the payoff amount is good through.

attributes.name: loan
attributes.description: The existing loan this payoff retires.

relationships.name: secured by
relationships.description: The application is secured by a home in the property vocabulary.

relationships.name: has
relationships.description: An application has conditions. The condition's wording stays on the condition entity.

relationships.name: becomes
relationships.description: A funded application becomes a loan.

relationships.name: refinanced by
relationships.description: A loan is refinanced by a later application. The link is a reference on that application, not a new kind of loan.

relationships.name: co-borrows on
relationships.description: A person co-borrows on an application. The same pair of entities as applies, a different edge.

relationships.name: funds
relationships.description: A refinance application funds a payoff of the loan it names.

relationships.name: retires
relationships.description: A payoff retires an existing loan. The amount stays on the payoff, not on this edge.
